column1: # M-LIGHT Phase 3 change declaration for RLT-SHD-012 (docs/prd/reference-lighting.md RLT-CNT-002, #6721).
# WRITTEN AFTER THE CODE IT COVERS: RLT-CNT-002 asks for a declaration checked in before the change, and
# the cosine-weighted shadow visibility (55ba81e20) landed without one. The sizes below are the measured
# effect of exactly that commit: anchors captured with its parent's engine (55ba81e20^, built release in
# a worktree), captures with 55ba81e20's, the same pose and tier per scene (the Phase 1b baselines), TAA
# without jitter, 64 frames, seed 0 against anchor seed 0, tolerance = the scene's two-seed floor + 0.01.
# docs/audits/MLIGHT_phase3_shd012_a11.txt holds the raw compare output.
# The requirement predicts the change only where a light's shadow rays cross a partly occluded emitter
# (penumbra pixels) and makes a lit pixel's visibility exactly 1. It does not predict a sign per region;
# the sign below is measured. The Phase 3 changes before this one (RLT-SHD-003, -007) have no anchors at
# all: step 4 of Phase 3's entry (anchors and declaration) was never run, so this declaration covers
# SHD-012 alone and A11 for the rest of Phase 3 stays open.
# Tiles are 32 x 32 px; 1280 x 720 has tiles x 0-39, y 0-21.
